    for _, v in ipairs(t1.value14) do
        v:Disconnect()
    end
end
})
v8:CreateToggle({
	Name = "TP Walk",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Callback = function(p26)
    t1.value18 = p26
    t1.value36()
end
})

	},

    t1.value19 = p27

    end
